registers.name: SR
registers.note: p.1: 12-bit serial-in parallel-out input shift register (SRI clocked in on CLK rising, MSB first); power-on value not given (0)

registers.name: DAC
registers.note: p.1: 12-bit DAC register, loaded from the shift register while LD is low; power-on value not given (0)

commands.name: Shift 12 bits
commands.note: p.4: bit 1 (MSB) .. bit 12 (LSB) on SRI, each sampled at CLK rising

protocol.note: no chip select: the shift register takes every CLK rising edge; LD low transfers it to the DAC register

pages: p.1 (description), p.2 (timing characteristics, VDD 4.75-5.25 V), p.3 (pin configuration), p.4 (write cycle timing)
notModeled: analog: multiplying current output, VREF input, RFB feedback resistor

shift register semantics: the DAC register takes the last 12 bits clocked in before LD falls; the model groups CLK bits in 12-bit words from power-on (no CS to resynchronize), so extra clocks misalign the words
power-on contents of the shift and DAC registers (not given; 0 used)
